annotations.title: List Practice Matches at an Event

description: Fetch the practice matches played at an FRC event, which get_event_matches does not include. Returns full match records (alliances, scores, score breakdown, timing). Practice results do not count toward rankings, and many events do not report them. Lighter variants: get_event_practice_matches_simple, get_event_practice_matches_keys.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.
